home.metaDescription: A selection of independent winemakers from the Côte des Bar, Les Riceys, Montgueux and Villenauxe-la-Grande, with a single point of contact in Troyes.
home.heroIntro: Meet the independent winemakers, the terroirs and the cuvées with character. A distinctive selection, led by an enthusiast at the heart of the Aube.
home.terroirTitre: The Côte des Bar and the Aube, in the south of Champagne
home.terroirTexte: The Aube has four terroirs. The Côte des Bar, on its Kimmeridgian marls, is pinot noir country. Les Riceys is the only Champagne village with three appellations. Montgueux, a chalk hill on the edge of Troyes, is chardonnay land. Villenauxe-la-Grande looks towards the Sézannais.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Champagne de l'Aube collects and protects your personal data: forms, newsletter, processors (Brevo, Netlify), cookies and your rights.
privacy.intro: This page explains simply what personal data we collect on this website, why, who it is shared with and how to exercise your rights.

responsable.title: Data controller
responsable.text:
Champagne de l'Aube, represented by Julien Mineo, Troyes (Aube, France). [TO BE COMPLETED: legal status, SIRET number, postal address]
Contact: contact@champagnedelaube.fr

donnees.title: Data collected
donnees.text:
• Forms (quote, booking, registration, contact): name, email and/or phone, business or company, town, number of people, preferred date, message.
• Newsletter: email address, language, sign-up page and date of your consent.
• In all cases: confirmation that you are 18 or older, the website language and the page you are writing from.

finalites.title: Why this data is used
finalites.text:
• To reply to your request and prepare a quote or booking (pre-contractual measures).
• To follow up our exchange: your contact details are saved in our address book (Brevo), sorted by profile (professional, company, private client, winemaker) (legitimate interest). This does not subscribe you to the newsletter.
• To send you news, only if you asked for it and confirmed by clicking the link received by email (consent).
• To protect the forms against automated submissions (legitimate interest).

destinataires.title: Who has access to your data
destinataires.text:
Your data is never sold or rented. Only Julien Mineo has access to it, along with these technical providers (processors), for the needs of the website:
• Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, France): sending emails and address book. Data hosted in the European Union.
• Netlify (United States): website hosting. Transfers covered by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
• Sanity (United States): management of the website's texts and photos. No form data is stored there.
• Cloudflare Turnstile (if enabled): anti-bot protection for the forms, without advertising cookies.

conservation.title: How long
conservation.text:
• Requests and contacts: 3 years after our last exchange, then deleted.
• Newsletter: until you unsubscribe (a link is included in every email). Proof of your consent is kept as long as you are subscribed.

droits.title: Your rights
droits.text:
At any time you can access your data, have it corrected or deleted, object to its use, restrict its use, obtain a copy, or withdraw your consent to the newsletter. Simply write to contact@champagnedelaube.fr.
If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority, the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).
